name: ancient stone mask
description:
A sinister mask made of a smooth green stone.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

name: ancient harp
description:
A harp made of black wood.  Faint hypnotic notes ring in the air each time you touch it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

name: ancient athame
description:
A ritual knife used by some ancient civilization.  Unreadable runes are carved into the handle.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

name: battery
description: Some free-floating battery charge.  It can be reloaded into rechargeable battery cells, but can never be unloaded.

name: soap bar
description: A cleansing agent shaped into a bar.

name: rolling paper
description: A thin paper strip intended for the rolling of cigarettes.

name: RA21E medical ampoule
description: A tiny glass vial filled with advanced fast-healing chemicals which can only be activated by a Rivtech jet injector device.  The packaged instructions describe its efficacy in dealing with infections, wounds, intoxications, envenomations, a

name: filter mask cartridge
description: A small, replaceable filter cartridge for an air filtration mask.

name: rock salt
description: A handful of rock salt crystals.  Could be refined into table salt.

name: fake 50lbs dynamite car bomb
description: Several sticks of explosives, bundled together with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, s

name: diesel
description: A petroleum-based fuel made from a byproduct of the gasoline making process.

name: spiral stone
description: A rock the size of your fist.  It is covered with intricate spirals; it is impossible to tell whether they are carved, naturally formed, or some kind of fossil.

name: book binder
description: A book binder.  With a pen and some paper you could copy some recipes from books into it.

name: cash card
description: A yellow plastic card used to electronically store money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.

name: wallet
description: A small, flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, and laminated cards.

name: travel wallet
description: A flat case with a neck strap, used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.

name: science ID card
description: An ID card that once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

name: Archery for Kids
description: Will you be able to place the arrow right into the bullseye?  It is not that easy, but once you know how it's done, you will have a lot of fun with archery.

name: mutagen chelator
description: A dangerous treatment that binds to mutagen present in the bloodstream and allows it to be excreted.

name: canola seeds
description: A heap of round black seeds, typically milled and pressed for their oil.

name: .30-06 5-round clip
description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five .30-06 rounds into a compatible firearm.

name: diving cylinder
description: A high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

name: packed disposable rocket launcher
description: A packed, disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.  Activate it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.

name: bicycle horn
description: A simple bulb horn found on many bicycles.  Activate it to honk.  Honk honk.

name: weather glass
description: Also called storm glass or 'Goethe barometer', The weather glass barometer consists of a glass container with a sealed body, half filled with water.  A narrow spout connects to the body below the water level and rises above the water level.

name: bear trap
description: A spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of

name: EOD helmet
description: An armored, electronically-shielded helmet containing a camera, a two-way radio, and a headlamp, all of which can be voice-activated for redundancy.  It is designed to protect against overpressure, fragmentation, impact, and heat.

name: tree spile
description: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

name: cent
description: A unit of currency equivalent to 0.01 US dollars.

name: betavoltaic cell
description: Harness the power of radiation in your own home!  It looks similar to a D-cell battery, but actually contains folded layers of radioactive material inside.  It can produce electricity for several years at a steady voltage… but it's barely e

name: moisturizer
description: A cosmetic preparation used for protecting, moisturizing, and lubricating the skin.

name: disconnected foot locker recharging station
description: A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

name: RA10K stimulant module
description: A pressurized multi-chamber glass vial filled with powerful chemical stimulants which can only be activated by a Rivtech stimulant delivery system.

name: activated carbon
description: A small amount of coal-derived carbon material with many small pores, used for the adsorption of harmful chemicals.  Most commonly employed within respirator filters, it traps and retains chemical gases and vapor contaminants while allowing

name: juvenile sourdough starter
description: A floury paste that is slowly going bad.  Someday it will be sourdough.

name: war flail
description: A stout pole with a large flanged mace head attached to the end with a short chain, a purpose-made combat version of the peasant flail.  It specializes in threshing people in metal armor, rather than grain.

name: JP8 fuel
description: A kerosene-based fuel used mainly by US military vehicles as a replacement for diesel and jet fuel, to simplify logistics.

name: exposed-wiring prototype
description: Some kind of prototypical electronic device with exposed wiring.  Some of the wires have bare ends that could be connected together.

name: credit card
description: A plastic card used to purchase goods and services.  It's useless now.

name: cash register
description: An electronic device for registering and calculating sales transactions.  It doesn't seem to be working.

name: lanyard
description: A flat, clear plastic sleeve for identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.  It has a neck strap attached.

name: military ID card
description: An ID card that once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

name: Car Buyer's Guide
description: Normally this glossy, ad-filled magazine about cars would be pointless, but it has a series of articles on haggling techniques.

name: purifier smart shot
description: An experimental stem cell treatment, offering limited control over which mutations are purified.  The liquid sloshes strangely inside of this syringe.

name: Marloss seed
description: This looks like a sunflower seed the size of your palm.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.  You could probably plant it.

name: SKS 10-round clip
description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load ten 7.62x39mm rounds into an SKS.

name: small diving cylinder
description: A small, high-pressure 200 bar diving tank that can contain 4 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

name: truck horn
description: A very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

name: light snare kit
description: A simple loop snare, comprising a carefully wound loop of string, two anchor points, and a tool to hammer them in.  It is suitable for immobilizing only small animals.  It has no means of harming its target, as live meat lasts longer.

name: handmade firemask
description: A custom-made leather gas mask faced with Nomex.  It must be prepared before use.

name: binoculars
description: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus th

name: clay pellet
description: A round projectile made of clay, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

name: radioisotope thermoelectric generator

name: mixed smokeless gunpowder
description: Firearm-quality gunpowder, mixed without concern for composition, burn rate, or shape, making it thoroughly useless for reloading ammunition.  It has been slightly ground to make its properties more uniform.

name: disconnected box battery charger
description: A small device for recharging batteries integrated into a small wooden storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its

name: liquid bandage
description: A polymer dissolved in solvent, with antiseptic added, for topical treatment of minor cuts and scrapes.

name: ultra-light battery
description: A light, coin-like battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  Used for watches, calculators, toys or similar low-power electronics.

name: freshly fed sourdough starter
description: A floury paste with sourdough starter mixed in.  It needs a day to recover its strength before it can be used again.

name: peasant flail
description: A stout pole with a wooden club attached to the end with a leather cord.  This farming tool was historically used to thresh wheat and occasionally people when the peasants got angry at their feudal lords.

name: avgas fuel
description: A specialized type of petroleum-based fuel used to power aircraft.

name: Bakelite phone
description: A vintage, bright-red Bakelite phone of famous Swedish design.  It would look almost normal, if not for the fact that its rotary dial has been replaced with a doorknob.

name: silver gas discount card
description: This card gives you a little discount on the purchase of gasoline.

name: plastic shopping bag
description: A bag used to carry groceries home.

name: game watch
description: A waterproof digital watch with a built-in electronic game system, powered by standard batteries.  Activate to play.

name: industrial ID card
description: An ID card that once belonged to a high-level technician.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

name: How to Succeed in Business
description: Useful if you want to get a good deal when purchasing goods.

name: soybean seeds
description: A pile of dry soybeans.  These are intended for planting, but there's no reason they couldn't be made into food.

name: 7.62x54mmR 5-round clip
description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five 7.62x54mmR rounds into a compatible firearm.

name: firefighter SCBA cylinder
description: A lightweight aluminum cylinder wrapped in carbon fiber, holding a highly compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

name: car horn
description: A car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

name: booby trap
description: A crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set it up and wait for some poor bastard to trigger it.

name: firefighter respirator mask
description: A full-face mask commonly used by firefighters.  When connected to an air source, the breathing apparatus provides excellent protection from smoke, flame, and other dangers.  Wear it, activate an air source, and activate it to engage airflo

name: hammock
description: A large sheet of cloth with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.

name: marble
description: A glass marble, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

name: aluminum foil
description: A sheet of thin foil made of aluminum.  Sometimes called 'tin foil' due to being made of tin in the past.

name: oxidizer powder
description: Volatile powdered chemical oxidizer.

name: disconnected advanced Stirling radioisotope generator

name: nicotine liquid
description: Liquid made up of propylene glycol, vegetable glycerin, flavorings, and nicotine.  Intended for use in an advanced electronic cigarette.

name: light battery (disposable)
description: A light battery cell, popular for any consumer-grade electronic: from remotes to mice, from clocks to thermometers.  This one can't be recharged.

name: sourdough starter
description: A precious mix of flour, water, molds, and bacteria from the air.  When you add flour and water to it, after a few hours it froths and rises.

name: expandable baton
description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Right now, it's collapsed.  Activate to expand.

name: gasoline
description: A highly flammable liquid fuel.  When under pressure, it has the potential for violent explosion.

name: golden comb
description: A small, delicate golden comb.  It was once carefully engraved, but time has smoothed its designs to illegibility.

name: gold gas discount card
description: This card gives you a good discount on the purchase of gasoline.

name: 30 gallon plastic barrel
description: A huge plastic barrel with a watertight lid.

name: smart watch
description: A touchscreen watch that comes with many uses, such as a calendar, alarm, and even a fitness app, for when you want to check your health on the go!

name: co-op badge
description: A manually-encoded badge giving you access to the artisans' workshop.  It even has your name written on the back.

name: Advanced Economics
description: A college textbook on economics.

name: 7.7x58mm 5-round stripper clip
description: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five 7.7x58mm rounds into a compatible firearm.

name: makeshift ammonia machine reactor
description: A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  As it uses primitive catalysts for the reaction, energy efficiency is very low.  This one is powered

name: yoke and harness
description: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

name: bubble wrap
description: A sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

name: handmade plated gas mask
description: A gas mask handcrafted from treated leather with a steel faceplate overtop.  It must be prepared before use.

name: net hammock
description: A large net with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.

name: BB
description: A small steel ball that can be fired from a BB gun.  Deals virtually no damage.

name: thread
description: A small quantity of thread that could be used for sewing.

name: lye powder
description: Powdered caustic soda, also known as sodium hydroxide.

name: oxygen concentrator
description: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.

name: caffeinated chewing gum
description: Sugar-free chewing gum with added caffeine.  It's a nice pick-me-up, one stick is equivalent to a strong cup of tea.

name: medium battery
description: A medium battery cell, wildly used in modern tools: heavy flashlights, two-way radios, security cameras, multiple of them make a tool battery, and some older generation of EV use thousands of this as the power storage.

name: oyster in shell
description: A medium-sized oyster.  Delicious served raw on the half-shell.  You'll need to shuck it to eat it.

name: medium steel battle axe
description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of medium steel, this isn't the greatest weapon ever forged but it has a decent edge and a real handle.

name: kerosene
description: A thin and clean-burning oil made for use in oil lamps.

name: shifting keyring
description: A smooth ring of steel, heavy under the weight of numerous keys.  The designs of the keys change over time, but none will fit any keyhole you have ever found.

name: platinum gas discount card
description: This card gives you a splendid discount on the purchase of gasoline.

name: steel drum (100 L)
description: A huge steel barrel with a watertight lid.

name: fitness band
description: A fitness band that can track your heartbeat, exercise level, and calories, and also has a clock.  Activate to see your metrics.

name: visitor's pass

name: Batter Up!
description: A baseball magazine that focuses on batting tips.  There are lots of colorful, full-page photos of skilled athletes demonstrating proper form and technique.

name: shotgun 6-round speedloader
description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 6 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

name: makeshift ammonia machine pipework
description: A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via Haber-Bosch process.  It also acts as a power source for all the low-pow

description: Heavy steel beams and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along, reinforced to withstand the rigors of the apocalypse and ill-advised off-roading.  You would still need separate arm

name: loose caltrops
description: A handful of small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

name: handmade half gas mask
description: A half-face gas mask handcrafted from treated leather.  It provides no protection for the eyes, and must be activated before use.

name: pot
description: A cooking pot, useful for boiling water and making all kinds of food.

name: 120mm HEAT
description: A 120mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could ruin anyone's whole day.

name: duct tape
description: A roll of incredibly strong tape.  Its uses are innumerable.

name: nitrox
description: A mixture of oxygen and nitrogen in proportions suitable for sustaining divers.

name: high pressure compressor unit
description: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.

name: methacola
description: A potent cocktail of amphetamines, caffeine and corn syrup, this stuff puts a spring in your step, a fire in your eye, and a bad case of tachycardia tremors in your somersaulting heart.

name: big tool battery
description: A heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and portable tools - drills, angle grinders, chainsaws.

name: hot chocolate
description: Also known as hot cocoa, this heated chocolate beverage is perfect for a cold winter day.

name: blackjack
description: A short, easily concealed bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded at the end of a short leather shaft.  Formerly used by law enforcement, this weapon is meant to stun or knock out the subject, although head strikes have a high ri

name: motor oil
description: An oil made for use in car engines.

name: engraved cube
description: A small cube of smooth rock.  A uniform grid of nine squares is engraved in each of its faces.

name: merch

name: steel drum (200 L)
description: A massive steel barrel with a watertight lid.

name: diving flashlight wrist mount
description: A proprietary wrist mount for a flashlight.  Not very useful on its own.

name: Anduril Industries ID card
description: An ID card for an Anduril Industries software engineer.

name: tactical baton defense manual
description: An informative guide to self-defense using clubs and batons.  Aimed at the law enforcement and military market, it is packed with time tested, no-nonsense information and written to be understandable for beginners.

name: shotgun 8-round speedloader
description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 8 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

name: makeshift nitrogen generator
description: A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects.  It includes a standard air filter for filtering out dust and other large particles, a deliquescent dryer to remove water vapor from air, and a

name: rebar grate
description: Several interlocked rods of rebar serving as makeshift armor, allowing for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.

name: loose glass caltrops
description: A handful of glass shards glued together to expose all their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.

name: handmade gas mask
description: A gas mask handcrafted from treated leather.  It must be prepared before use.

name: cast-iron pot
description: This hefty black pot is made from cast iron and coated in a sturdy enamel.

name: solid hydrogen canister
description: A canister of pressurized hydrogen so heavily compressed it has turned solid.  With proper equipment, it could be heated into plasma.

name: copper wire
description: A length of plastic-jacketed copper cable, of the type used in small electronics.

name: extinguishing agent
description: A dry chemical solution effective at extinguishing fires.

name: disconnected glassblower's crucible
description: An electric crucible, powered by your electric grid.  Designed for melting large quantities of glass for batch crafting and production of large items, it needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

description: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color

name: heavy plutonium fuel battery (disposable)
description: A battery that uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged

name: horchata
description: A sugary drink from Central America infused with rice, milk, and cinnamon.

name: bokken
description: A solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.

name: crude oil
description: A thick black slurry that can be refined to produce usable products including gasoline or diesel.

name: Utah teapot
description: A squat teapot with a minimalist design.  Its surface shines under the glow of unseen light sources.

name: Hub 01 Gold Coin
description: A small but surprisingly heavy gold coin.  One side is etched with circuitry and the other side reads 'Hub 01 exchange currency'.

name: reusable plastic sack
description: A large and sturdy sack, made out of woven polypropylene.  Popular choice to store sand, gravel, cement, or stop some local flood.

name: fedora
description: A high-crowned, wide-brimmed, sable-colored fedora.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.  The perfect hat for treasure hunting.

name: Advanced Physical Chemistry
description: A university-level textbook on advanced principles of physical chemistry and all its branches: thermochemistry, electrochemistry, solid-state chemistry, photochemistry, quantum chemistry et cetera.

name: shock absorber
description: A makeshift combination of springs and scrap that protects a particular section of a vehicle from the shock of impacts.  The springs can absorb a surprising amount of damage.

name: crossbow trap
description: A simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When the tripwire is pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single bolt can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

name: PAPR helmet
description: A helmet fit with a transparent full-face mask.  On the back of the helmet is a long tube which attaches to a powered air purifying respirator system.  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, a

name: casserole pot
description: A ceramic pot made for both cooking and serving, particularly one-pot dinners.

name: smokeless shotgun powder
description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in shotgun shells.

name: raw copper wire
description: A length of copper wire ready to be covered with plastic.

name: tear gas spray
description: A noxious aerosolized irritant used to fend off attackers both human and bear alike.

name: steel grille
description: A metal grille.  It can be used as a framework for making a chemical catalyst.

name: adhesive bandage
description: A small medical dressing made of a piece of sterile cloth and sticky tape, used for small injuries not serious enough to require a full-size bandage.

name: military plutonium fuel cell (disposable)
description: A battery that uses a huge plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  Although it stores a stupendous amount of power, it cannot be

name: Mexican hot chocolate
description: This semi-bitter chocolate drink made from cocoa, cinnamon, and chilies traces its history to the Maya and Aztecs.  Perfect for a cold winter day.

name: crutches (pair)
description: A pair of crutches.

name: crude lamp oil
description: A crude, natural oil made for use in pre-modern oil lamps.

name: glitching stopwatch
description: A small digital stopwatch, looking slightly old by today's standards.  Its digital display prints ever-changing gibberish.

name: FlatCoin

name: nylon bag
description: A square nylon bag designed to carry a folded portable stove.

name: thermal electric socks (pair)
description: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

name: The Modern Tanner
description: An in-depth and easy to read guide that details a very modern take on the ancient art of leather tanning.

name: car battery
description: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.

name: land mine
description: A military anti-personnel fragmentation mine that is triggered when stepped on.

name: shielded PAPR-EEG helmet
description: A white plastic helmet fit with a transparent full-face mask.  It has been modified for some unknown purpose.  On the back of the helmet is a long tube which attaches to a powered air purifying respirator system.  Once activated it will com

name: stock pot
description: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, used for making soup stocks.  You could fit a whole turkey in there, with a bit of shoving.

name: smokeless pistol powder
description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in pistol ammunition.

name: plutonium fuel cell
description: This is neither a fuel cell, nor nuclear, but the name stuck.  It uses plutonium-244 as a catalyst to stabilize a complicated nanocompound that can store enormous amounts of power.  Unfortunately, it cannot be recharged by conventional mean

name: bird litter
description: Bird droppings, feathers, and soiled bits of rubbish.

name: cobalt-60 pellet
description: A piece of unshielded radioactive material that used to be a part of some nuclear industry equipment.  You have yet to find some use for it, and you probably shouldn't stand near it.

name: alcohol wipe
description: A wet wipe saturated with alcohol and stored in a sterile package.  Used for personal hygiene or disinfecting small wounds.

name: nanomaterial canister
description: A steel canister containing carbon, iron, titanium, copper, and other elements in specifically engineered atomic-scale configurations.  A nanofabricator can assemble them into usable items.

name: clean water
description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.

name: makeshift crutches (pair)
description: A pair of wooden makeshift crutches.
